# TG WS Proxy Android v1.2.5.2-diag2

Experimental JSON export fix; based on v1.2.5.2-diag1.

- Prepare nonempty UTF-8 JSON in private app storage before launching Android's document picker.
- Save to chosen document using a process-wide IO coroutine, not a disposable Compose coroutine.
- Flush and verify destination when the provider supports readback; log DIAG EXPORT prepared / written / failed bytes.
- Preserve diagnostic panel selection through normal Activity recreation.
- Existing log analyzer, opt-in TCP/DNS checks and full TXT export stay as they are.
- No changes to Rust transport, connection pools, routing, defaults or Cloudflare media fallback.
- Stable Latest remains v1.2.5.1.
